generation.geometryRule: The matching deterministic preview is authoritative; A01 supplies material and photographic style only. An AI render never changes canonical geometry.

renders.title: FRONT
renders.promptContract: Copy CAM_FRONT preview geometry exactly: one 16.4 x 12.0 m rectangular one-storey volume, integrated front-west garage, one 25 degree hipped roof, four front openings in canonical order, two front corner downpipes, canonical driveway/path; apply A01 materials, garden and warm photographic light only; add no geometry.

renders.title: REAR / GARDEN
renders.promptContract: Copy CAM_REAR preview geometry exactly: the same rectangular volume and hipped roof, four rear openings visible large-small-large-small, two rear corner downpipes and canonical terrace; map living, kitchen and bedroom visibility to the scheduled openings; apply A01 materials, varied garden and warm photographic light only; add no geometry.

renders.title: LEFT
renders.promptContract: Copy CAM_LEFT preview geometry exactly: the same rectangular volume and triangular side-valm, master-bedroom window then narrow garage personnel door in screen order, two facade-corner downpipes and canonical west-side landscape; use A01 materials and approved A02/A03 photographic consistency only; add no geometry.

renders.title: RIGHT
renders.promptContract: Copy CAM_RIGHT preview geometry exactly: the same rectangular volume and triangular side-valm, smaller bedroom window then wider living-room window in screen order, no door, two facade-corner downpipes and canonical east-side landscape; use A01 materials and A02/A03/A04 photographic consistency only; add no geometry.

checks: A02 contains exactly the four scheduled front openings in canonical order.
A03 contains exactly the four scheduled rear openings in camera-visible large-small-large-small order.
A04 contains exactly the master-bedroom window and garage personnel door in CAM_LEFT screen order.
A05 contains exactly the smaller bedroom window and wider living-room window in CAM_RIGHT screen order, with no door.
All four images retain a single rectangular one-storey volume and one continuous hipped roof.
All four images show the facade-corner downpipe pair required by their view.
Visible A03 interiors follow the room and interior visibility map without duplicated room functions.
Visible A04/A05 interiors follow the master-bedroom, bedroom-2 and living-room assignments.
A01 material intent is retained without using A01 as geometric evidence.
